# teardown scope, parts, and shop calendar

Case: CASE-022
Document control number: SPEC-0022
Effective revision: R4
Superseded revision visible in archive: R9
Subject: pump repair MWO-0022
Primary measure: seal housings required by the approved teardown scope
Source finished or header quantity: 1
Effective usage per finished or header unit: 1 EA
Unit: EA
Eligibility definition: seal housings in stock and eligible for this repair
Exclusion definition: seal housings quarantined or reserved, plus damage outside the approved scope
Control: approved scope change, part readiness, and qualified repair window

## Applicability

Apply only to NS-000022, organization SEA, and CASE-022. A matching title, filename, supplier, or item description is insufficient without the immutable record and released revision.

## Reconciliation rule

Build the supported measure from the independent observed rows and subtract only rows carrying an effective exclusion reason. Do not use archive, draft, other-case, or other-plant rows in either side of the equation.

## Timing and authority

Internal timing comes from electrical-shop base and recovery slots; external timing is conditional on seal-housing standard and expedite dates. Protected work is not displaceable. Separate approval is required for the escalation path, and a faster date does not waive the control.

## Output control

The system action must preserve the source identity, effective revision, supported measure, and scoped approval. This specification deliberately does not contain a netted result, selected option, or final outcome date.
